tweets.1: 🧵 1/7 You are The Resistance. Spies are hidden among you. Win 3 missions to win the game.
tweets.2: 2/7 Each mission: a Captain proposes a team. Everyone votes to approve/reject. 5 rejects in a row = Spies win.
tweets.3: 3/7 Approved team goes on the mission. Each team member secretly plays a card: SUCCESS or FAIL (Spies only).
tweets.4: 4/7 Mission result: normally 1 FAIL fails the mission. Special rule: Mission 4 with 7+ players needs 2 FAILs.
tweets.5: 5/7 After each mission, Captain passes to the next player in order. Track who proposed what.
tweets.6: 6/7 Resistance: always play SUCCESS. Spies: coordinate quietly (or don’t) to sabotage missions.
tweets.7: 7/7 First side to 3 mission wins takes the game. Good luck, and don’t get caught.

roleDescription.resistance: You are fighting against the spies. Always play SUCCESS on missions.
roleDescription.spy: You are infiltrating the resistance. You may play SUCCESS or FAIL on missions.
